results.title: 无上内秘真藏经
results.issue: Chongxuan-leaning Yuanshi-system ten-juan work on inner true treasury and liberation is a known Daozang title; chapter themes (hiển đạo, tam bảo, etc.) should be treated as approximate labels for juan contents.

results.title: 太上洞渊三昧帝心光明正印太极紫微伏魔制鬼拯救恶道集福吉祥神咒
results.issue: Dongyuan-line long-title spirit spell, Ziwei / “đế tâm–quang minh chính ấn” anti-demon function is consistent with Dongyuan spell literature; “thường đồng quyển với chú khác” is edition-specific and only partially verifiable from catalogs without the exact fascicle pairing.

results.title: 太上玄灵北斗本命延生真经
results.issue: Most popular Beidou scripture: birth-star petition, repentance, longevity, disaster relief—accurate. Dipper lords governing life–death–fortune and altar practice are standard; entry is otherwise unproblematic.

results.title: 太上说东斗护命妙经
results.issue: East Dipper of the Five Dippers set for life-protection is correct; generic “cứu khổ / giải tai” summary is fair but thin—little unique content risk of conflating with neighboring dipper scriptures.

results.title: 太上说西斗记名护身妙经
results.issue: West Dipper “record the name” / body-protection function is traditional; folk-religion elaborations may exceed the short scriptural core. Overall type is right.

results.title: 太上三生解冤妙经
results.issue: Three-life karmic grievance-release morality/salvation text is a known popular type; specific causes (sát sinh, nợ nần…) are typical contents of the genre but not all may appear in every print of this exact title.

results.title: 太上说五苦三戒经
results.issue: Title and moral-instruction profile (five sufferings / three precepts) are plausible; without a pinned Daozang locus, risk of title confusion with other wuku / jielü texts—treat as partial pending firm bibliographic ID.

results.title: 太上九天延祥涤邪经
results.issue: Jiutian blessing / purge-evil, house-cleansing type is consistent with popular Daoist scripture naming; content summary is generic and may not distinguish this title from similar apotropaic texts.

results.title: 太上赤书玉篇真文
results.issue: Chishu yupian zhenwen as foundational Lingbao “heavenly writing” / five-direction red true-writs is standard; “Thượng Thanh/Linh Bảo” joint label is a bit loose—core is Lingbao, later read in broader Shangqing–Lingbao heavenly-text tradition.

results.title: 大洞玉经
results.issue: Central Shangqing scripture, ~39-chapter recitation for spirit-union is correct for the Dadong tradition; “hoặc hệ liên quan” hedge is appropriate because multiple Dadong/Yujing recensions exist.

results.title: 太上老君说上七元真人金轩玉字经
results.issue: Laojun-preached Seven Origins / jade-characters type title exists in Daoist catalogs; detailed “kim hiên ngọc tự” doctrine is only sketchily verified—partial pending closer text match.

results.title: 灵宝自然经诀
results.issue: Lingbao ritual-key text on natural Dao and liturgy is a known title class; describing it as handbook more than long philosophy is fair, but exact scope varies by witness.

results.title: 太上三五正一盟威修真玉经
results.issue: Zhengyi Mengwei / sanwu cultivation title fits the lineage; mixing precepts, registers, and neixiu is typical. Exact independence vs. relation to the broader Zhengyi Mengwei corpus needs catalog caution.

results.title: 太上紫微玄都雷霆玉经
results.issue: Shenxiao/thunder-method scripture centered on Ziwei Xuandu is genre-correct; “then chốt” status is evaluative. Verify exact Daozang placement before treating as the core thunder classic.

results.title: 玄天上帝感应经
results.issue: Xuantian Shangdi (Zhenwu) ganying scripture of northern pacification and miraculous response is a real popular type; widespread temple use is right. Not always in Zhengtong Daozang under this exact short title.

results.title: 太上说三官大帝本行经
results.issue: Sanguan “benxing” (hagiographic) scripture is a known popular genre; entry truncated mid-sentence—cannot fully verify the remaining claims from the provided text.

results.title: 上清九丹上化胎精中记经
results.issue: Early Shangqing; Zhen’gao mentions related “九丹…胎精中记”; embryo from nine-heaven qi, twelve knots, and visualization of twenty-four perfected / xuanfu xuanmu to unbind knots are standard for this text family. Good overall, details depend on recension.

results.title: 太上洞玄灵宝出家因缘经
results.issue: Lingbao encouragement-to-ordain text with precepts, vows, and great aspiration lists is correct in type; exact “sơ chân thập giới / bát sự / thập thệ thập nguyện” counts should be matched to the specific edition.

results.title: 太上说五斗星君本行真经
results.issue: Correct that the exact title is hard to find as such in Zhengtong Daozang; redirecting to the Five Dippers set and 五斗金章受生经 is reasonable. “未详” authorship and “not found” stance are appropriately cautious—not a false positive claim of a solid independent classic.

results.title: 太上灵宝净明洞神上品经
results.issue: Southern Song Jingming core scripture, 35 pian / 2 juan, loyalty-filiality root, Xu Xun transmission frame are standard. Correction that it is Taiping bu not Dongshen bu is a strong bibliographic claim—generally accepted for the Daozang placement, keep as partial if catalog wording differs slightly; “净明秘法/真经” alternate names are used but not always strictly identical.

results.title: 太上说长生益算妙经
results.issue: Fuller common title 太上老君说长生益算妙经, Dongshen bu, longevity/fate-extension with Dongji Changsheng and liujia, talismans—standard. Place-name “Thiền Lê” and exact ritual cast should be treated as edition-dependent.

results.title: 太上洞玄灵宝三元威仪自然经
results.issue: Corresponds to the Yulu jianwen sanyuan weiyi natural scripture; Lu Xiujing catalog; only middle-yuan yulu ~80 master–disciple rules survive in Daozang—this is well supported. Gold/Jade/Yellow original triad and Dunhuang links are standard scholarly points.

results.title: 太上灵宝净明法序
results.issue: Short Jingming preface claiming Shangdi → Taiyang Zhenjun → Xu Zhenjun and “35 pian” pointing to the Jingming dongshen shangpin jing is the usual description; a few-hundred-character length is approximate.

results.title: 道德真经玄德纂疏
results.issue: Qiang Siqi (Former Shu), 20 juan anthology of Tang Xuanzong, Heshanggong, Yan Zun, Li Rong, and Cheng Xuanying—standard. Minor risk of over-specifying every cited layer depending on printed table of contents.

results.title: 老子道德经序诀
results.issue: Attributed to Ge Xuan, early Lingbao transmission layer; five-section myth of Laozi–Yin Xi, Heshanggong–Wendi, Lingbao line, and Taiji reading keys—standard. “Ngũ thiên văn tự” alternate naming can confuse with the Laozi text itself—flag as partial for naming.

results.title: 金石簿
results.issue: Fuller title often 金石簿五九数诀, Dongshen bu, list of ~45 minerals with grades is the usual brief; exact count 45 is approximate across witnesses.

results.title: 太清五髓经
results.issue: Correct cautious stance: no reliable independent Zhengtong Daozang / Schipper–Verellen / CRTA hit. Treating as misnomer, lost, or rare variant is appropriate—not an inaccurate positive claim.

results.title: truncated 69 (Lý Vinh / truncated)
results.issue: Source text truncated around “của Lý Vinh. Có thể nhầm/tên biến th”—cannot fully verify without the complete entry; Li Rong-related Laozi commentary naming confusions are common and the self-flagged possible mix-up is appropriate.
